StemSplitter - which model for which job
========================================

StemSplitter   -  1 model in, 2 stems out
  1 Vocals / Instrumental
      BS-Roformer-Viperx-1297  -  best instrumental score
      MelBand Roformer | Vocals by Kimberley Jensen  -  best vocals score
  2 Lead / Backing
      Mel-Roformer-Karaoke-Aufr33-Viperx  -  newest karaoke model
      5_HP-Karaoke-UVR  -  classic karaoke, VR arch
  3 Drums
      kuielab_a_drums  -  old; Demucs is better
      kuielab_b_drums  -  old; Demucs is better
  4 Bass
      kuielab_a_bass  -  old; Demucs is better
      kuielab_b_bass  -  old; Demucs is better
  8 Brass / wind
      17_HP-Wind_Inst-UVR  -  only wind model; stem_2 = woodwinds
  9 Other
      kuielab_a_other  -  old; Demucs is better
      kuielab_b_other  -  old; Demucs is better

StemSplitter4  -  1 model in, 4 stems out
  3-9 separate stems
      htdemucs  -  the standard one
      htdemucs_ft  -  fine-tuned, best quality, slower

StemSplitter6  -  1 model in, 6 stems out
  5 Guitar / 6 Piano
      htdemucs_6s  -  the only model that gives guitar and piano

StemSplitterFX -  1 model in, cleaned + removed out
  10 Dereverb
      MelBand Roformer | De-Reverb by anvuew  -  highest scoring
      MelBand Roformer | De-Reverb Less Aggressive by anvuew  -  less aggressive
  11 Denoise
      Mel-Roformer-Denoise-Aufr33  -  highest scoring
      Mel-Roformer-Denoise-Aufr33-Aggr  -  more aggressive
  12 De-echo
      UVR-De-Echo-Normal by FoxJoy  -  normal
      UVR-De-Echo-Aggressive by FoxJoy  -  stronger
Which node for which process
----------------------------
  1 Vocals / Instrumental    StemSplitter
  2 Lead / Backing vocals    StemSplitter    (the karaoke models)
  3 Drums                    StemSplitter4   Demucs beats the kuielab models
  4 Bass                     StemSplitter4
  5 Guitar                   StemSplitter6   only htdemucs_6s does this
  6 Piano                    StemSplitter6   only htdemucs_6s does this
  7 Strings                  nothing in the library does this
  8 Brass / wind             StemSplitter    woodwinds only; no brass model exists
  9 Other                    StemSplitter4
 10 Dereverb                 StemSplitterFX
 11 Denoise                  StemSplitterFX
 12 De-echo                  StemSplitterFX

Where there is no choice, because the library has nothing to give
  5 Guitar, 6 Piano   htdemucs_6s is the only model that produces them
  7 Strings           nothing at all
  8 Brass             only a woodwind model; nothing brass-specific

Named by the guide but not usable here
  Waves Clarity, Accentize DeRoom2, DX Revive, iZotope RX,
  Acon DeVerberate, LALAL.AI  - commercial, no headless build
  DeepFilterNet               - not installed

Model weights are downloaded into  ComfyUI/models/audio_separator/
